item.title: Video: Andrea Martin, Phillipa Soo & Steven Pasquale Sing in HIGH SPIRITS
item.description: New York City Center has released new footage of songs from the current Encores! production of High Spirits. The cast also features Saturday Night Live alum Rachel Dratch as Edith, Katrina Lenk as Elvira, alongside film and television star Campbell Scott (House of Cards) as Dr. Bradman and Jennifer Sánchez (Real Women Have Curves) as Mrs. Bradman. item.title: Brandon Contreras to Take Over for David Cumming in OPERATION MINCEMEAT
item.description: Brandon Contreras will take over the role of Charles Cholmondeley & Others in Operation Mincemeat on Broadway, when original cast member David Cumming departs the production in February. As previously announced, original cast members David Cumming, Claire-Marie Hall, Natasha Hodgson, Jak Malone, and Zoë Roberts will perform through February 22nd 2026. item.title: Robert Icke’s OEDIPUS Breaks Studio 54 Weekly Box Office Record In Final Week
item.description: Robert Icke's new adaptation of Oedipus starring Mark Strong and Lesley Manville broke the record for highest weekly gross at Studio 54, taking in $1,212,949.00 over its final week, which ended Sunday, February 8, 2026. The limited engagement began previews on October 30, 2025, and opened to overwhelming acclaim on November 13. The previous record of $1,074,778.00 was set by An Act of God in August of 2015. item.title: Helen J Shen Joins Cast of New CBS Vampire Comedy ETERNALLY YOURS
item.description: Helen J Shen, star of Broadway's Maybe Happy Ending, has been cast in the new TV pilot Eternally Yours for CBS. According to Deadline, the performer will appear as a series regular in the new vampire comedy, which is from Ghosts creators Joe Port and Joe Wiseman. Shen is set to star alongside Parker Young, as well as the previously announced Ed Weeks, Allegra Edwards and Jaren Lewison. item.title: Liza Minnelli To Appear At The Streicker Center For NYC Launch Of New Memoir
item.description: Liza Minnelli will make a rare public appearance at the Temple Emanu-El Streicker Cultural Center in New York City for an exclusive event marking the publication of her forthcoming memoir, Kids, Wait Till You Hear This!. The book is published by Hachette Book Group and is written as told to Minnelli’s longtime collaborator Michael Feinstein.
